headword: {介護福祉士|かいごふくしし}
gloss: certified care worker; care welfare specialist

definitions.gloss: certified care worker; a nationally licensed professional who provides physical and daily-life assistance to the elderly and disabled
definitions.explanation: A nationally certified professional in Japan who provides hands-on physical care and daily living assistance to elderly and disabled individuals. The qualification is established by law and requires passing a national exam.

examples.japanese: {介護福祉士|かいごふくしし}の{資格|しかく}を{取|と}った。
examples.english: I obtained the certified care worker qualification.

examples.japanese: {介護福祉士|かいごふくしし}は{高齢者|こうれいしゃ}の{生活|せいかつ}を{支援|しえん}する。
examples.english: Certified care workers support the daily lives of the elderly.

examples.japanese: {高齢化|こうれいか}{社会|しゃかい}の{中|なか}で{介護福祉士|かいごふくしし}の{需要|じゅよう}が{高|たか}まっている。
examples.english: In an aging society, the demand for certified care workers is growing.

notes:
Composed of {介護|かいご} (nursing care), {福祉|ふくし} (welfare), and {士|し} (professional, specialist). This is a national qualification in Japan established by the {社会福祉士及|しゃかいふくししおよ}び{介護福祉士法|かいごふくししほう} (Social Worker and Care Worker Act). Holders provide hands-on care including bathing, eating, and mobility assistance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {介護福祉士|かいごふくしし}の{資格|しかく}: certified care worker qualification
- {介護福祉士|かいごふくしし}{試験|しけん}: care worker certification exam
- {介護福祉士|かいごふくしし}として{働|はたら}く: to work as a certified care worker

CULTURAL NOTE:
With Japan's rapidly aging population, {介護福祉士|かいごふくしし} is one of the most in-demand professional qualifications. Japan has also begun accepting foreign care workers under special visa programs to address labor shortages in this field.

RELATED WORDS:
- {社会福祉士|しゃかいふくしし}: certified social worker — focuses on counseling and coordination rather than physical care
- {介護士|かいごし}: care worker — informal term, not necessarily nationally certified
- ケアマネージャー: care manager — coordinates care plans
